extracted.intended_audience: health care journalists; AHCJ members; journalists covering health and health care
extracted.subtask_short: health care journalism principles and policies
extracted.subtask_description: Organizational principles and policy guidance for journalists who report on health care, covering ethical standards, corrections, conflicts of interest, republishing, government transparency, and professional development. Meant to guide reporting, editing, broadcasting and interactions with sources and institutions.

rubrics_metrics.name: AHCJ mission
rubrics_metrics.description: Our mission is to improve public understanding of health care issues by advancing the quality, accuracy and visibility of health care journalism.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Work with thousands of journalists each year to improve the quality, accuracy and visibility of health care reporting and editing internationally.

rubrics_metrics.name: Goal: Support highest standards of reporting/writing/editing/broadcasting
rubrics_metrics.description: To support the highest standards of reporting, writing, editing, and broadcasting in health care journalism for the general public and trade publications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applies across formats (print, broadcast, online) and audiences (general public and trade publications); implies emphasis on accuracy, clarity, and professional craftsmanship in all health coverage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Goal: Develop a strong and vibrant community of journalists
rubrics_metrics.description: To develop a strong and vibrant community of journalists concerned with all forms of health care journalism.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Encourages networking, peer support, shared resources, and professional exchange among journalists covering health topics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Goal: Raise the stature of health care journalism
rubrics_metrics.description: To raise the stature of health care journalism in newsrooms, the industry, and the public, as a whole.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Advocates for recognition of health journalism's importance and for its integration and support within news organizations and the broader public discourse.

rubrics_metrics.name: Goal: Promote understanding between journalists and sources
rubrics_metrics.description: To promote understanding between journalists and sources of news about how each can best serve the public.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Encourages transparent interactions and shared expectations so that reporting serves the public interest; implies clear sourcing practices and source accountability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Goal: Advocate for the free flow of information
rubrics_metrics.description: To advocate for the free flow of information to the public.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Supports policies and practices that maximize public access to accurate and timely health information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Goal: Advocate for professional development opportunities
rubrics_metrics.description: To advocate for the improvement of professional development opportunities for journalists who cover any aspect of health and health care.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Supports training, fellowships, conferences, and other learning opportunities to elevate reporting quality.

rubrics_metrics.name: Bylaws (organizational governance)
rubrics_metrics.description: Find details about AHCJ membership, its board of directors, membership meetings and other important business.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Procedural rules governing membership, board composition, meetings and organizational decision-making; relevant for understanding governance and potential conflicts of interest.

rubrics_metrics.name: Statement of Principles
rubrics_metrics.description: Learn how AHCJ helps journalists covering health care issues meet their unique challenges.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Top-level statement intended to orient journalists to AHCJ's core ethical and professional expectations when covering health topics (details provided on the linked page).

rubrics_metrics.name: Self-Promotion and Exploitation
rubrics_metrics.description: Learn why journalists should avoid featuring their own actions or spotlighting people they may help.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Warns against using journalistic platforms for personal promotion or exploiting subjects; implies practices to preserve independence and avoid conflicts between personal interests and reporting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Corrections Policy
rubrics_metrics.description: Learn how our approach to corrections helps us achieve our goal to communicate objectively and precisely.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Establishes how and when errors are corrected, promoting accuracy and transparency; linked policy contains procedures for issuing corrections and minimizing misinformation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Conflicts of Interest Policy
rubrics_metrics.description: See how the AHCJ’s board of directors and executive committee handle and disclose possible conflicts of interest.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Requires disclosure and handling procedures for potential conflicts among leadership and members to preserve organizational and journalistic integrity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fundraising Policy
rubrics_metrics.description: Read how our ethical approach to fundraising minimizes the possibility and appearance of inappropriate influence.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guides fundraising activities to avoid actual or perceived influence on editorial independence; includes safeguards described on the linked policy page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Republishing Policy
rubrics_metrics.description: Follow the guidelines for sharing content, stories and art from AHCJ.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies permissions, attribution, and permissible reuse for AHCJ content; ensures content is republished in ways that respect rights and context.

rubrics_metrics.name: Government Transparency Policy
rubrics_metrics.description: Read our recommendations on the release of information concerning deaths, epidemics or emerging diseases.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Advises on public access to government-held health information, balancing transparency with accuracy and public safety; intended to guide reporting and requests for information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Release Guidance
rubrics_metrics.description: See our guidelines for journalists and public health officials to consult when decisions must be made about what information should be released.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides practical guidance for deciding what health information to release and how to communicate it responsibly; aimed at both journalists and public health officials.
